documents.title: Discretionary Mandate — Terms
documents.body:
MERIDIAN HOLDINGS — DISCRETIONARY MANDATE

1. Scope: The holder of this mandate has discretionary authority over the funded line for the purpose of productive deployment of capital.
2. Constraints: (a) No single counterparty may exceed 40% of the line without partner sign-off. (b) All transfers above 10,000 must carry a memo. (c) Activity is subject to quarterly audit.
3. Reporting: A written summary of decisions is required at each stopping point.
4. Standard of care: Act as a prudent operator would with the firm's own money.
